events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls
sc=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv',index_col=0)
md=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
X=mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr()
bc=pd.read_csv('barcodes.tsv.gz',header=None)[0]
types=md.cell_type.unique().tolist()
print('shape',sc.shape,X.shape,'types',md.cell_type.value_counts().to_dict())
j=np.where(bc.values=='Spot_710-1')[0][0]
y=X[:,j].toarray().ravel()
print('spot index,total,nonzero',j,y.sum(),(y>0).sum())
# raw means, median, library normalized means
for label,A in [
 ('raw mean',np.column_stack([sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].mean(axis=0).values for t in types])),
 ('raw sumprofile',np.column_stack([sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].sum(axis=0).values for t in types])),
 ('norm mean',np.column_stack([(sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].div(sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].sum(1),axis=0)).mean(axis=0).values for t in types]))]:
 coef,res=nnls(A,y)
 if label=='raw sumprofile': coef=coef*200
 print(label,'res',res,'coef',dict(zip(types,np.round(coef,4))))
 print('shares',dict(zip(types,np.round(coef/coef.sum(),4))))
# type correlations
means=sc.groupby(md.cell_type).mean().T
for transformed in ['raw','log']:
 yy=y if transformed=='raw' else np.log1p(y)
 A=means if transformed=='raw' else np.log1p(means)
 print(transformed,'corr',A.apply(lambda z: np.corrcoef(z,yy)[0,1]).sort_values(ascending=False).to_dict())
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -u - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
print('imports1',flush=True)
from scipy.io import mmread
from scipy.optimize import nnls
print('imports2',flush=True)
sc=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv',index_col=0)
md=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
X=mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr()
bc=pd.read_csv('barcodes.tsv.gz',header=None)[0]
types=md.cell_type.unique().tolist()
print('shape',sc.shape,X.shape,'types',md.cell_type.value_counts().to_dict())
j=np.where(bc.values=='Spot_710-1')[0][0]
y=X[:,j].toarray().ravel()
print('spot index,total,nonzero',j,y.sum(),(y>0).sum())
means=np.column_stack([sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].mean(axis=0).values for t in types])
coef,res=nnls(means,y)
print('raw mean res',res,'coef',dict(zip(types,np.round(coef,4))))
print('shares',dict(zip(types,np.round(coef/coef.sum(),4))))
normmeans=np.column_stack([(sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].div(sc.loc[md.index[md.cell_type==t]].sum(1),axis=0)).mean(axis=0).values for t in types])
coef,res=nnls(normmeans,y)
print('norm mean res',res,'coef',dict(zip(types,np.round(coef,4))))
print('shares',dict(zip(types,np.round(coef/coef.sum(),4))))
for transformed in ['raw','log']:
 yy=y if transformed=='raw' else np.log1p(y)
 A=means if transformed=='raw' else np.log1p(means)
 co={t:np.corrcoef(A[:,i],yy)[0,1] for i,t in enumerate(types)}
 print(transformed,'corr',dict(sorted(co.items(),key=lambda x:-x[1])))
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -u - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.io import mmread
sc=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_counts.csv',index_col=0); md=pd.read_csv('spatial_q_sc_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
y=mmread('matrix.mtx.gz').tocsr()[:,710].toarray().ravel()
means=sc.assign(cell_type=md.cell_type).groupby('cell_type').mean()
print('reference library means')
print(sc.sum(1).groupby(md.cell_type).agg(['mean','std','min','max']).round(2))
print('\\n50-gene block sums for spot:')
for start in range(0,1000,50): print(f'{start:3}-{start+49:3}: {y[start:start+50].sum():.0f}',end='  ' if start%100 else '\\n')
print('\\n\\ntype marker top50 enrich sums:')
for t in means.index:
 others=means.drop(t).mean()
 top=np.argsort(-(means.loc[t].values-others.values))[:50]
 print(t,'spot',y[top].sum(),'ref own',means.loc[t].values[top].sum().round(1),'ref other',others.values[top].sum().round(1), 'range', (top.min(),top.max()))
# Fit leave-one-type combinations and SSE
from scipy.optimize import nnls
A=means.values.T; types=list(means.index)
for omit in [None]+types:
 inds=[i for i,t in enumerate(types) if t"'!=omit]
 c,res=nnls(A[:,inds],y)
 print('"'omit',omit,'res',round(res,3),dict(zip([types[i] for i in inds],np.round(c,3))))
PY"
